verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI has building blocks for unattended, long-running crawls. It ships a Dockerized FastAPI server for deployment (gh-5), a real-time monitoring dashboard (gh-6), crash recovery with `resume_state` and `on_state_change` callbacks (gh-8, gh-30), automatic retry with proxy fallback (gh-4) and adaptive crawling that decides when to stop (docs-3). However, there is no evidence of built-in scheduling, triggers or recurring background jobs, and a community member reports users needing external tools like n8n to automate it (comm-5, comm-6). Missing for 10: native scheduler or cron-style recurring jobs, event triggers, first-party documentation of background automation workflows, and hands-on corroboration of autonomous operation.
